visual.general_description: Grayscale ultrasound image with printed scanner settings, a yellow label reading RIGHT and one white arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale ultrasound image with a black border and a thin blue strip at the very top edge that holds cut-off, illegible text fragments. Printed text at the upper left reads "AP 50.1% MI 0.7 TIS 0.1" and, in yellow, "RIGHT". At the upper right a grayscale bar and a vertical scale with the numerals 0, 1, 2 and 3 appear, with the brand text "mindray" and the printed settings "M9", "B", "F 6.6~13.5", "D 3.0", "G 66", "FR 70", "DR 105" and "iClear 5". A small green triangular marker sits beside the vertical scale. A large dark, rounded, fluid-like region fills the central image with granular gray tissue above and a brighter, textured gray zone below it. Along the lower edge of the dark region there are irregular bright fragments with a few small bright blobs. One white arrow with a straight shaft points toward the left-hand part of these fragments. No calipers or measurement boxes are visible.
